newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill on health-care REITs.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill on health-care REITs.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it started coverage of Meditrust SBI as near- and long-term accumulate.

-- Merrill said it also restarted coverage of Nationwide Health Properties Inc and Health Care Property Investors Inc as near- and long-term accumulate and Health and Retirement Properties Trust as near-term neutral and long-term accumulate.
-- Meditrust ended Wednesday at 35-1/4, Nationwide Health Properties at 22-1/4, Health Care Property at 33-1/2, and Health and Retirement Properties at 18.
